name: Golden Legion's Stayed Blade
benefit:
If you deal an amount of damage to a creature
 that would slay it outright, you can pull that attack, instead
 dealing only enough damage to reduce its hit points to –1,
 and leave it stable.
flavor:
When you’re dealing with large and secretive organizations,
 a dead enemy is just a corpse, but a captured enemy can be
 a tool.
